C-24.Name: Baseline Markdown for agent output: footnotes on, relative image paste/drop, GitHub + Obsidian callouts, front matter properties view, documented
C-24.IntentSummary: Turn on footnotes and relative `assets/` image storage by default, make pasted and dropped images land as standard `![](assets/…)` markdown (fixing the unwired Tauri image drop), render GitHub alerts and Obsidian callouts (with folding) as callouts in the editor and in export, show YAML front matter as a read-only properties table that opens the YAML source on click, and document all of it. Byte-identical round-trip is pinned by fixtures captured before any render change.

T-001.Title: W0: baseline fixtures and diagnosis before any behaviour change

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Lexer corpus gains footnotes, front-matter (comments, quoted values, lists), task-lists, github-alerts, obsidian-callouts (aliases, custom titles, -/+ folds, nested), image-links; their goldens are captured on the unmodified lexer.

markdown-round-trip.test.js: for every new fixture, markdownToState then exportMarkdown reproduces the input byte for byte on the unmodified code (if a fixture does not round-trip at baseline, record it as a pre-existing limitation instead of hiding it).
Root cause of the pasted-bitmap `` form identified and recorded in this plan's evidence; current Finder image drop behaviour recorded (code reading: mt::drop-image has no listener).

T-002.Title: W1: defaults — footnotes on, relative assets/ directory (R-1, R-2)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: preferences.js and static/preference.json: footnote=true, imagePreferRelativeDirectory=true, imageRelativeDirectoryName='assets'; stored preferences are not migrated.
preference-defaults.test.js pins the three defaults in both sources and that the two sources agree.

T-003.Title: W2: image paste text form and Finder drop (R-3, R-4)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Pasted bitmap is written as `![alt](assets/…)`; explicit resize still writes ``. Unit-pinned at the root-cause site.

mt::drop-image is handled: an image dropped onto a saved document goes through imageAction (copied into assets/, relative link inserted at the drop position or cursor); dropping onto an unsaved document uses the existing global-folder fallback. Unit-pinned with a stubbed imageAction.
Chromium e2e: synthetic clipboard PNG paste into a saved document produces a file under assets/ and the relative markdown link.

T-004.Title: W3: callouts — GitHub alerts and Obsidian callouts with folding (R-5, R-7)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: src/muya/lib/utils/callout.js (START_BLOCK_CALLOUT_DETECT): pure detection of type, alias-resolved style, title and fold from a blockquote's first line, per GitHub and Obsidian rules.
Muya renders a detected blockquote as a callout container (icon, title, per-type colour) in light and dark themes; the marker line stays editable when the cursor is in it; fold state is view-only.
Export HTML renders callouts (fold → details/summary).
Token parity goldens for all pre-existing corpus files unchanged; round-trip byte-identical for the callout fixtures including after fold toggles; webkit-perf gate green.

src/muya/lib/utils/frontMatterProps.js (START_BLOCK_FRONT_MATTER_PROPS): a dependency-free parser for flat YAML (scalars, quoted scalars, inline lists, block lists, comments) that returns null for anything else (nested maps, anchors, multi-line scalars, invalid input).

Muya renders a parseable YAML front matter block as a read-only key/value table (lists as chips); click or Enter switches to the existing YAML source; leaving the block switches back; non-parseable, TOML and JSON front matter keep the current block. A preference restores the plain YAML block.
Round-trip byte-identical for the front matter fixture after entering and leaving source view.

T-006.Title: W5: MAS folder access for assets/ writes

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In the app-store build, an image write into a document folder without a security-scoped grant asks once for folder access (M-047 bookmark persisted); on decline the image goes to the container image folder with an absolute link and a user notice. No silent failure.
Unit-pinned on the renderer decision path with stubbed IPC; Rust side covered by existing M-047 tests plus any new command test.
README Features: one line each for footnotes, front matter (properties view), task lists, callouts (GitHub `[!NOTE]` and Obsidian), image paste/drop into assets/. site/guide mirrors it.

T-008.Title: W7: full gates, live-app smoke, governance, reviews

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Full vitest with coverage thresholds; chromium e2e; webkit-perf gate; grace lint 0 errors.

Live app, local release build: screenshot Cmd+V and Finder drop into a saved document → assets/ + relative `![](…)`; callouts and the properties table in light and dark; fold toggles; footnote jump. Evidence recorded in the spec Completion.
V-M-011 / V-M-012 scenarios and commands; M-011 / M-012 graph notes; CHANGE_SUMMARY entries.

Review-1.Angle: correctness and round-trip: callout detection vs GitHub/Obsidian rules, byte-identical save across view toggles, lexer parity and the C-30 sticky invariant, image text form

Review-2.Angle: file-write safety and MAS sandbox: assets/ path resolution, overwrite/collision, drop of non-image or huge files, folder-access prompt and fallback, no silent failures
